fichas.title: Finishing Beef Cattle: Stall Forms and Shed Layouts
fichas.summary: Reference sheet on finishing beef cattle under single or group management. It compares short, tethering, straw-bedded, and fully slatted stalls; illustrates shed plans and sections, manger fittings, animal-space requirements, recommended slatted-floor dimensions, and fodder requirements. The text emphasizes drainage, safe movement of animals, ventilation, and roof pitches of about 20°. Group management commonly uses 6–15 animals of similar age and weight.
uses: Housing cattle singly or in groups
Moving animals safely into and out of stalls
